modelingWizard.domainHelp: The domain every table this wizard creates is registered under: its namespace for access control and querying.
modelingWizard.validTimeHelp: The column saying from when each version was true in the business. With the recorded time, it lets past versions be queried.
modelingWizard.recordedTimeHelp: The column saying when each version was recorded in the source.

roleIn.dimension: A star schema dimension, built as an entity keyed on its business key
roleIn.fact: The star schema's fact, built as a fact related to each dimension
roleIn.hub: A Data Vault hub, built as an entity keyed on the business key
roleIn.satellite: A Data Vault satellite, built as an entity keyed on its hub's business key
roleIn.linkSatellite: A Data Vault link satellite, built as an entity keyed on the link's keys
roleIn.effectivity: A Data Vault effectivity satellite, built as an entity keyed on the link's keys with valid time
roleIn.link: A Data Vault link, built as a fact with no measures whose grain is the participating keys
roleIn.sameAs: A Data Vault same-as link, built as a fact with no measures relating the hub to itself

process.title: Business process
process.intro: The business process this star schema measures, where its events are recorded, and what kind of fact it is.

grain.title: Grain
grain.intro: What one row of the fact stands for. Declare the grain before the dimensions and measures.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.intro: The who, what, where and when of each event: each dimension, how it changes, and whether it is conformed.

measures.title: Measures
measures.intro: The numbers the process produces, how each is aggregated, and whether it can be summed.

star.processHelp: The business process the fact records, in the business's own words (order fulfillment, claims handling). It names the fact table.
star.sourceHelp: The registered table holding the process's events. The fact is read from it: its grain, its measures and its links to the dimensions.
star.factTypeHelp: Transaction: one row per event. Periodic snapshot: one row per period, the state at its end. Accumulating snapshot: one row per item, updated as it passes each milestone.
star.grainStatementHelp: One row of the fact, said plainly. It goes in the fact's description.
star.grainHelp: The column(s) of the process's table that identify one fact row. Measures are aggregated to this level.
star.dimensionsHelp: Each dimension the fact is analysed by. A new one is built from its own table; a conformed one is an existing dimension the fact shares with other facts.
star.dimNameHelp: What the dimension describes (customer, product, date). It names the dimension table.
star.viaHelp: The column of the process's table that points at this dimension.
star.conformedHelp: Pick an existing dimension to share it with other facts, so they can be compared on it. Leave it empty to build a new dimension.
star.dimSourceHelp: The registered table the dimension's rows are read from.
star.dimKeyHelp: The column(s) identifying one member of the dimension. Rows are deduplicated on it, and the fact column points at it.
star.dimAttributesHelp: The descriptive columns analysts filter and group by.
star.scdHelp: Type 1 overwrites: only the current value is kept. Type 2 keeps every version. Snapshot keeps the state as of each load. Type 2 and snapshot need the valid and recorded times.
star.measuresHelp: The numeric columns the process measures. Each becomes a measure of the fact, aggregated to the grain.
star.additivityHelp: Additive: can be summed across every dimension (an amount). Semi-additive: not across time (a balance). Non-additive: never summed (a ratio, a price).

missing.process: Name the business process, its domain and the table where it is recorded.
missing.grain: Pick the column(s) that identify one row of the fact.
missing.dimensions: Each dimension needs a name and a fact column, and either a conformed dimension or its own table and key (with valid and recorded times for type 2 or snapshot).

hubs.title: Hubs and business keys
hubs.intro: The core business concepts, the business key that identifies each, and the record source the key comes from.

links.title: Links
links.intro: The units of work between the concepts, and whether each relationship can end.

satellites.title: Satellites
satellites.intro: The descriptive attributes of each hub or link, grouped by source, rate of change or sensitivity, and how far back their history goes.

rules.title: Business vault
rules.intro: The business rules that derive new values from the raw vault. Optional.

vault.hubsHelp: One hub per core business concept (customer, product, order), identified by its business key: the key the business itself uses, not a system's surrogate.
vault.conceptHelp: The concept the hub stands for. It names the hub.
vault.recordSourceHelp: The registered table the business keys are loaded from.
vault.businessKeyHelp: The column(s) the business identifies the concept by.
vault.sameAsHelp: When two keys name the same instance (a customer known by two systems' numbers), the table pairing them. Leave it empty when there is none.
vault.linksHelp: One link per unit of work between hubs (a customer places an order). A link holds only the participating keys.
vault.linkNameHelp: What the link records. It names the link; left empty, the link is named after its hubs.
vault.linkSourceHelp: The registered table recording the unit of work, holding each participating hub's key.
vault.linkHubsHelp: The hubs that take part. A link relates two or more hubs.
vault.endsHelp: When a relationship can end (a customer changes account manager), an effectivity satellite records when each one starts and ends.
vault.depthHelp: Every version: each change to a satellite's attributes is kept and can be queried as of any time. Current values only: a change overwrites.
vault.satellitesHelp: The descriptive attributes of a hub or link. Split them into several satellites by source, rate of change or sensitivity.
vault.satParentHelp: The hub or link whose attributes the satellite holds.
vault.satNameHelp: What sets this satellite apart (its source, crm; or its subject, address). Added to its name.
vault.satSourceHelp: The registered table the attributes are read from.
vault.satParentKeyHelp: The column(s) of the satellite's table holding the hub's business key or the link's keys.
vault.satAttributesHelp: The descriptive columns this satellite holds.
vault.groupedByHelp: Why these attributes are together: they come from one source, change at one rate, or share a sensitivity (personal data kept apart).
vault.multiActiveHelp: When several rows are active at once for one key (a customer's phone numbers), the column(s) telling them apart. Leave empty otherwise.
vault.rulesHelp: A business vault rule derives a value from the raw vault (a customer's lifetime value). It is recorded in the description of the table it derives from, and built afterwards as a view.
vault.ruleTextPlaceholder: lifetime value = sum of order totals

missing.hubs: Pick the domain, and give each hub a business concept, a record source and a business key; a same-as link needs its table and both keys.
missing.links: Each link needs its table, at least two hubs, the key of each, and valid and recorded times when it ends.
missing.satellites: Each satellite needs what it describes, its table, that key and its attributes, with valid and recorded times when every version is kept.
missing.rules: Say which table each rule derives from.
missing.satelliteKey: A satellite's key has as many columns as the key of what it describes, in the same order.

review.title: Review
review.intro: What each answer becomes in Provisa: an entity or a fact, its key or grain, its history and its relationships. Names follow the method's convention; change any of them here.
review.nameHelp: The table's name. It is the method's conventional name; clear the prefix if consumers should not see it.
review.historyKept: every version, by valid time {{validTime}} and recorded time {{recordedTime}}
review.ruleNotCreated: Business vault rule "{{rule}}": recorded in its table's description; build it as a view over these tables.
review.draftNote: Each description is a first draft for a steward to revise in Registered Tables.
review.nameTaken: Two tables have the same name. Give each its own.

result.draftNote: Their descriptions are first drafts: revise them in Registered Tables.
result.oneWay: The wizard only creates. Change these tables in Registered Tables or the entity/fact form; the wizard does not regenerate them.

desc.dimension: Draft: star schema dimension "{{name}}" of the {{process}} process, keyed on {{key}}, read from {{source}}. When a member changes: {{scd}}.
desc.fact: Draft: star schema fact of the {{process}} process ({{factType}}). Grain: {{grain}}. Dimensions: {{dimensions}}. Measures: {{measures}}.
desc.hub: Draft: Data Vault hub of the {{concept}} concept, keyed on the business key {{key}}, from the record source {{source}}.
desc.sameAs: Draft: Data Vault same-as link of {{hub}}: {{master}} and {{duplicate}} name the same {{concept}}, from {{source}}.
desc.link: Draft: Data Vault link for the unit of work "{{name}}" between {{hubs}}, on the keys {{keys}}, from {{source}}.
desc.linkEnds: The relationship can end; its effectivity satellite records when.
desc.effectivity: Draft: Data Vault effectivity satellite of {{link}}: when each relationship starts and ends, by valid time {{validTime}} and recorded time {{recordedTime}}.
desc.satellite: Draft: Data Vault satellite of {{parent}}: {{attributes}} from {{source}}, grouped by {{grouping}}. History: {{history}}.
